## Fortexa payment and security review

Please complete this checklist before requesting review.

### Security-sensitive behavior

- [ ] Auth behavior: changed / not changed
- [ ] Session behavior: changed / not changed
- [ ] Policy behavior: changed / not changed
- [ ] XDR behavior: changed / not changed
- [ ] Network behavior: changed / not changed
- [ ] Audit behavior: changed / not changed

### Dependencies and configuration

- [ ] Dependencies changed: yes / no
- [ ] Package scripts changed: yes / no
- [ ] Workflows changed: yes / no
- [ ] Configuration or environment variables changed: yes / no

### Verification and safety

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed payment or security behavior.
- [ ] I did not add, commit, or expose secrets.
- [ ] I did not add an automatic editor task.
- [ ] I have described any security or payment impact above.
